title: The Satyam confession — India's largest accounting fraud
statement: Raju confessed by letter that Satyam's balance sheet carried roughly $1 billion of fictitious cash and assets, inflated for years, calling the fraud 'like riding a tiger, not knowing how to get off without being eaten.'
outcome: Satyam's board was superseded by government order; the company was auctioned to Tech Mahindra within months. Raju was convicted in 2015, sentenced, and the case became India's defining corporate-governance lesson.
